review_candidates.title: Tender Manager Mechanical
review_candidates.description: Company Description Smart Group is a leading company in Egypt, established in 2005, with a strong presence in the energy and construction sectors. The group includes Smart Power, which focuses on electromechanical contracting, solar solutions, and digitalization solutions, and Smart Industries, which specializes in low voltage panel boards, transformers, ring main units, and medium voltage switchgear. Smart Group aims to be a key player in the energy sector and construction works in Egypt and the Middle East. The organization is committed to quality, safety, environmental preservation, and providing high-standard services and products that are fit for purpose. Smart Group prioritizes customer satisfaction by delivering reliable solutions with strong value for money. Role Description The Tender Manager Mechanical is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, responsible for managing the end-to-end tendering process for mechanical and MEP projects. This includes reviewing tender documents, specifications, and drawings, preparing technical and commercial proposals, and coordinating with engineering, procurement, and finance teams to ensure accurate cost estimates and compliant submissions. The role involves analyzing risks, value engineering opportunities, and ensuring that offers meet client requirements, industry standards, and company policies. The Tender Manager Mechanical will collaborate with project and sales teams, participate in clarification meetings, and maintain organized records of tenders, revisions, and approvals. The position also requires tracking tender outcomes, contributing to bid/no-bid decisions, and supporting continuous improvement of tendering procedures and tools. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Mechanical Engineering knowledge and practical experience, ideally in energy, construction, or related electromechanical fields. Candidates should possess Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) and Plumbing systems skills, including understanding of designs, specifications, and installation requirements. Candidates should possess Project Management skills, including planning, coordination, and monitoring timelines, budgets, and deliverables for tender-related activities. Candidates should possess Team Management skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional collaboration, delegate tasks, and align stakeholders toward tender objectives. Relevant bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related discipline; professional certifications in project management or tendering are an advantage. Strong analytical, numerical, and cost estimation abilities, with attention to detail and proficiency in MS Office and relevant engineering or costing software. Effective communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to interact professionally with clients, consultants, and internal teams. Previous experience in tender management or technical offers within electromechanical contracting, energy projects, or industrial solutions is highly beneficial.

Think of it as moving from craftsperson to factory designer — except the factory improves itself every week, and the products ship to customers whose brands millions of people interact with daily. Deliver production features end-to-end — from UI polish to backend logic to deployment. No handoffs, no waiting on separate QA cycles. Compound team capability — document and distribute the reusable workflows, prompts, and tooling you develop so one person's breakthrough becomes everyone's baseline.
